teaser: Eight goals at the Etihad, Arsenal battered at Brighton, and a **£4.0m** defender outscoring almost everyone. Gameweek 5 did not do quiet.
fullWriteup:
**Man City 5-3 Sunderland** was the headline, but **Brighton 3-0 Arsenal** was the result that actually hurt — plenty of squads had Arsenal defence in them. **Brentford 3-0 Chelsea** was another kicking, Villa won 3-2 at Tottenham, and Coventry quietly walked out of the City Ground with a 1-0 and a clean sheet. Liverpool ground out 1-0 at Bournemouth, while Leeds and Palace served up the blank.

**Semenyo** and **Brobbey** led the way on **17 points** each, Brobbey doing it from a losing side at **£5.7m**. Behind them, **Dasilva** returned **15 points** at just **£4.0m** — the best value on the board — with Schuster, **Groß** and Tarkowski all on **14**. Villa's Manzambi (13) and Buendía (12) rewarded anyone who backed that trip to Spurs.

Price moves are all Arsenal, and mostly one way: **Gyökeres**, Lewis-Skelly, Hincapie and Tzolis all dropped **£0.1m** after that Brighton showing, while Raya and Konsa somehow ticked up. Diakité and Rayan fell at Bournemouth, Ji-soo and Wilson at Brentford. If you're selling Arsenal assets, you're already late.
